obituaries.full_text:
He is survived by his wife, Carol Ahshapanek, of the home in Anadarko, Oklahoma, 
  3 sons and their spouses: Darren and Michelle Ahshapanek, Anadarko, Oklahoma; 
  Don and Loriann Ahshapanek, Jr., Hattiesburg, Mississippi; Brian and Lonna Ahshapanek, 
  Seattle, Washington. 7 grandchildren: Rebekah Renwick, Daniel Ahshapanek, Andrew Ahshapanek, Sean 
  Ahshapanek, Don Ahshapanek III, Tia Ahshapanek, Niya Ahshapanek; 4 great-grandchldren 1 brother, Marvin Johnson, New Jersey, and 1 sister, Carmelita Alaniz, Albuquerque, 
  New Mexico. He was preceded in death by his parents.
